sentences.show: People are quietly replacing their phone keyboards with their voice.
Apps like Wispr Flow turn rambling speech into clean, ready-to-send text, in any app.
sentences.say: Apps like Whisper Flow turn rambling speech into clean, ready-to-send text, in any app.

sentences.show: Here's who leads on iPhone, why people get hooked, and how a Swedish version could run entirely on the phone.
First, the plumbing: iOS won't let a keyboard use the microphone.
sentences.say: First, the plumbing: i O S won't let a keyboard use the microphone.

sentences.show: So every voice keyboard is two parts: a thin keyboard, and a main app that records in the background.
Starting a session means a trip to that app, and since iOS 26.4, users must swipe back by hand.
sentences.say: Starting a session means a trip to that app, and since i O S twenty-six point four, users must swipe back by hand.

sentences.show: So who's winning?
Wispr Flow is the reference, with 4.8 stars from about seventeen thousand ratings.
sentences.say: Whisper Flow is the reference, with four point eight stars from about seventeen thousand ratings.

sentences.show: 9to5Mac called Aqua Voice the best dictation app its reviewer had ever used, and Make Tech Easier called Willow the most accurate.
sentences.say: Nine to Five Mac called Aqua Voice the best dictation app its reviewer had ever used, and Make Tech Easier called Willow the most accurate.

sentences.show: Superwhisper, Typeless and Monologue round out the field, nearly all of them in the cloud.
The most interesting ideas come from the edges.
Aqua lets you edit by voice: make this shorter, translate it, spell a name.
Typeless keeps only what you meant when you change your mind mid-sentence.
And small apps like Outspoken and KeySay already run transcription and AI cleanup entirely on the phone.
sentences.say: And small apps like Outspoken and Key Say already run transcription and A I cleanup entirely on the phone.

sentences.show: Ranked by leverage, one feature dominates: text you don't have to edit.
Punctuation, filler words, self-corrections and lists, all handled.
Then come one-tap capture anywhere, getting names and jargon right, speed you can feel, and editing by voice.
Why do people get hooked?
Speaking is about three times faster than thumb-typing.
Wispr says eighty-nine percent of its messages go out without an edit, sent in about half a second.
sentences.say: Whisper says eighty-nine percent of its messages go out without an edit, sent in about half a second.

sentences.show: People stop proofreading and start thinking out loud.
Wispr reports seventy percent of users still active after a year.
sentences.say: Whisper reports seventy percent of users still active after a year.

sentences.show: Trust turns into habit.
Can it all run locally? Yes, but not inside the keyboard.
iOS kills a keyboard at around seventy megabytes, so the models run in the main app.
sentences.say: i O S kills a keyboard at around seventy megabytes, so the models run in the main app.

sentences.show: There, the GPU is off limits, and from iOS 27 the Neural Engine needs a special entitlement.
sentences.say: There, the G P U is off limits, and from i O S twenty-seven the Neural Engine needs a special entitlement.

sentences.show: On the CPU, Gemma 4 E2B writes about twenty-five tokens a second, so a full rewrite takes about four seconds.
sentences.say: On the C P U, Gemma four E two B writes about twenty-five tokens a second, so a full rewrite takes about four seconds.

sentences.show: Stream it into the text field instead, and words appear in about half a second.
And Swedish is wide open.
Apple's Swedish dictation adds no punctuation, and its new AI dictation in iOS 27 is English only.
sentences.say: Apple's Swedish dictation adds no punctuation, and its new A I dictation in i O S twenty-seven is English only.

sentences.show: Klang's Pianissimo model reaches about four and a half percent word error rate in Swedish, on the device.
Add cleanup that understands Swedish fillers, split compounds and number formats, and you have something nobody offers today.
The plan: nail edit-free Swedish text, make sessions painless, and learn each user's words.
Then add voice editing and translation.
Track one number above all: how often a message goes out untouched.
Talk, don't type. In Swedish. With nothing leaving the phone.
